title: Machine Hallucination
content: Refik Anadol has created the effect a 'machine hallucination' at ArtTecHouse in New York City.Link to YouTube videoTextures projected on flat surfaces suggest flowing textures and floating numerals.Link to YouTube videoThe effect is to disorient the viewer, forcing them to question whether the apparent hallucination emerges from their own consciousness or from somewhere else..----Via Design Boom
